# RESOURCES.md format

Curated high-trust sources. Knowledge comes from here, not parametric guesses.

```md
# {Topic} Resources

## Knowledge

- [Book/article — author](url)
  What it covers. Use for: …

## Wisdom (Communities)

- [Forum or class](url)
  Use for: real-world critique.

## Gaps

- {What the mission needs that you have not found yet}
```

- High-trust only. Annotate every entry. Prune shallow or off-mission sources.
- If the user opted out of communities, record that so later sessions stop proposing them.
